laptops

mr.christy told me that there was a laptop with some errors where it would keep crashing, so i decided to take a look into it.

connected it to an external monitor because it wouldn't display at first then ran

sfc /scannow

to repair any corrupted windows files.

turns out, three system driver files were corrupt, and running the command fixed the crashing errors

trademark project

since i decided to start working on chamber's trap from valorant, i started 3d modeling it.

i started by making the legs before then extruding a base for the legs and then working upwards. the dimensions are still kinda random as i'm not too sure how big it needs to be (i'll adjust after making the pcb and stuff) but those can be subject to change.

with that done, i started working on the top half of the trademark

i created the circular base then spent a lot of time on this back part which holds up the "head" which is where the camera will be located. not quite sure how i'm going to make the head spin, but i'll figure something out (if i do decide to make it spin)

with this done, the only thing left to do is figure out how to connect the head to the back part (probably snap fit, but my 3d modeling skills aren't good enough for that yet).
